question: Which company owns the jewellery brand Tanishq, and since when has it been part of that company?
answer: Tanishq is owned by Titan Company Limited, and its beginnings under Titan date to 1994. However, 1996 is the better-supported year for its launch as a jewellery brand. Titan’s official sources disagree on the launch date: its franchising page says 1994, while its heritage timeline and an earnings-call transcript say 1996.

## Tanishq: About Us and Titan Company History

**Tanishq is a jewellery brand of Titan Company Limited**, the company established in 1984 as a joint venture between the Tata Group and the Tamil Nadu Industrial Development Corporation (TIDCO). ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/business-division/jewellery-division?utm_source=openai))

### Key milestones
- **1984 — Titan founded:** The company began with a focus on India’s watch industry. ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/our-heritage?utm_source=openai))
- **1987 — Watch production began:** Titan commenced watch production and launched the Titan brand. ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/sites/default/files/2025-02/Q3FY25%2520Earnings%2520Presentation.pdf?utm_source=openai))
- **1994 — Jewellery beginnings:** Tanishq’s “About” page traces its journey to precious-stone-studded 18K gold watches in 1994. Titan also inaugurated its jewellery manufacturing facility that year. ([tanishq.co.in](https://www.tanishq.co.in/about-tanishq?utm_source=openai))
- **1996 — Tanishq jewellery launch:** Titan’s corporate heritage timeline lists 1996 as the launch of Tanishq jewellery. This distinguishes the formal launch milestone from the earlier 1994 beginnings. ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/our-heritage?utm_source=openai))
- **1997 — Karatmeter introduced:** Tanishq introduced gold-purity testing to help customers assess their gold and improve transparency. ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/our-heritage?utm_source=openai))

### Official “About Us” sources
- **Tanishq — About Tanishq:** Brand origins, its Hosur manufacturing facility, craftsmanship, and quality commitments. ([tanishq.co.in](https://www.tanishq.co.in/about-tanishq?utm_source=openai))
- **Titan Company — Our Heritage:** The company’s historical timeline, including Tanishq’s launch. ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/our-heritage?utm_source=openai))
- **Titan Company — About Us:** Background on Titan and its expansion into jewellery and other lifestyle categories. ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/about-us?utm_source=openai))

**Both 1994 and 1996 appear in Tanishq’s history, but refer to different milestones:**

- **1994 — Brand origins:** Titan dates Tanishq’s beginnings to 1994. Tanishq’s own history says its journey began with 18-karat gold watches studded with precious stones. ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/business-opportunities/franchising?utm_source=openai))
- **1996 — First retail store:** Tanishq opened its first boutique on **Cathedral Road, Chennai**. Tata also uses 1996 as the jewellery brand’s launch year in some histories. ([titancorporategifting.com](https://www.titancorporategifting.com/about-us?utm_source=openai))
